name: get-ai-cited
description: See how often leading AI answer engines cite and name B2B companies, from published, dated measurements, and check whether any website is readable by AI.

interface.longDescription:
Get AI Cited measures AI visibility: how often AI answer engines cite a company's website as a source and name the company when buyers ask for recommendations. Each measurement asks a category's buyer questions three times on four leading AI answer engines, and the method is published.

Without an account you can:
- Look up a company's published Cited Score, its result on each engine, and the companies named instead
- See category leaderboards (payments APIs, embedded insurance, cyber insurance, small business insurance, policy administration software, wealth management software, loan origination software, fund administration)
- Check whether any website is technically readable by AI crawlers, with the exact fixes
- Read how the score is measured, including what it does not measure

Get AI Cited customers can sign in to read their private measurements: tracked companies, full reports with score history, every buyer question and engine result, competitors named, sources cited, and the stored AI answers themselves.

Every figure comes from a dated snapshot. The plugin is read-only: it cannot change data, run scans or see billing.
defaultPrompt: What is Checkout.com's AI visibility, and who gets named instead?
What is Cover Genius's AI visibility?

positive.description: Look up a published company's Cited Score
positive.prompt: What is Checkout.com's AI visibility, and who gets named instead?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a score card for Checkout.com in Payments APIs: Cited Score 12/100 from the snapshot of 27 Sep 2026, results for ChatGPT (0), Perplexity (18), Claude (6) and Gemini (23), and the companies named instead (Stripe, Adyen, PayPal, Airwallex). The answer quotes the snapshot date.
Lists the measured cyber insurance companies ranked by how often AI engines name them, with each company's share of answers and engine count, and the snapshot date (30 Sep 2026). Chubb is first.

positive.description: Check any website's technical AI readiness
positive.expected_behavior: Shows an AI readiness card for stripe.com with a score out of 100 and pass/check results for bot protection, AI crawlers in robots.txt, indexability, HTML content, structured data, sitemap and llms.txt, plus the most useful fix.

positive.prompt: How is the Cited Score measured?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains that the score is out of 100, weighted 70% to how often an engine cites the company's own website and 30% to how often it names the company, from fixed buyer questions asked three times on ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and Gemini, and states what the score does not measure.

positive.description: Signed-in customer reads their own report
positive.prompt: List my tracked companies, then show my full report for Checkout.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks the user to sign in to Get AI Cited on first use. After signing in with the test account, lists one tracked company (Checkout.com, Demo account) and shows its full report: Cited Score 12/100, score history, results per buyer question and engine, and competitors named.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in New York tomorrow?
Write a Python function that reverses a string.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.1: Removes country targeting so the plugin is available in all supported countries (1.0.0 was US-only). No changes to tools, skills or metadata.
